title: It Was at This Moment He Knew
blurb: There is a specific frozen second between a mistake and its consequence, and this narration lives there. The skateboard is still in the air, the firework has begun to tilt, the reply-all has gone but the responses have not arrived yet — and a deadpan voice arrives to confirm, kindly, that the person involved has just worked out what is about to happen. It became a cornerstone of mid-2010s fail editing because it converts a disaster into a documentary. One of the most quoted editing sounds ever recorded.
origin: The narrator line from classic fail-video edits of the mid-2010s.
